_comment: Stable prod fixtures the probe reads (never writes). Owned by the probe's own
non-admin account security-probe@tetapi.dev (role=user, 15.8) — NOT by the
owner's admin account any more. If a fixture disappears the dependent check
reports SKIP with the reason, never a fake PASS.
s8: entity created by session 15.3 (2026-08-05) with one public and one private
block, left in place precisely as the S-8 regression fixture. The private block's
title is 'private-block-s8-SECRET' — the id being public is fine, the API must
never return the row to a non-owner. Since S-17 (2026-09-14) the entity itself
MUST be public (is_public=is_published=true), otherwise /blocks 404s and the
check can only SKIP. This one is read ANONYMOUSLY, so its owner is irrelevant;
it still sits under the owner's account and was deliberately left there.
s17: the probe account's one and only entity, private (is_public=false,
is_published=false); every by-UUID read (base/preview/proof/blocks) must 404
anonymously and 200 for the owner (= the probe key).
s21: one Pi CAM device of that same probe entity, paired then REVOKED on prod
(2026-10-01, roadmap 15.8 — the justified prod write, see README). The key is
stored WITHOUT its pk_live_ prefix; it is worthless by construction (server
erased it, api_key IS NULL). device-upload with it must 401 and the owner's
GET /devices must still list the device with revoked_at set.
GET /devices resolves the caller's FIRST business, so the probe account must
keep owning exactly one entity — do not create a second one under it.
check can only SKIP.
s17: a private (is_public=false, is_published=false) entity of the same test
account; every by-UUID read (base/preview/proof/blocks) must 404 anonymously
and 200 for the owner.
s21: one Pi CAM device of the same test account, paired then REVOKED on prod
(2026-09-20, api PR #29 live check — the one justified prod write, see README).
The key is stored WITHOUT its pk_live_ prefix; it is worthless by construction
(server erased it, api_key IS NULL). device-upload with it must 401 and the
owner's GET /devices must still list the device with revoked_at set.

s22: a permanent pre_verified_unclaimed entity (TETA Security S-22 Probe Fixture, slug teta-security-s-22-probe-fixture) created 2026-10-03 via bulk-preverify, anchored to example-anchor.test (RFC 6761 reserved TLD, unclaimable by construction). claim/domain/check with a foreign domain must 403.
s27_device_signature: one LIVE (non-revoked) Pi CAM device of the same test
account, registered with a real P-256 SPKI key (api PR #35, 1.29). Its
device_id is recorded here (non-secret); its X-Device-Api-Key is NOT in this
file — it's a live write credential, kept only in the owner-provisioned
SEC_PROBE_DEVICE_API_KEY GitHub secret / ~/.tetapi/test_device_api_key (same
pattern as SEC_PROBE_API_KEY, see README). The check sends a forged
content_signature, asserts device_signature_verified comes back false, then
deletes the one Media row it created — self-cleaning, not an accumulating
prod write.
